**New 2026-11-19** (part of the visual-showdown pivot). See `REQUIREMENTS.md` M4.

Dependencies: `F11`, `F19`

Let the crowd pick "best" — opened only after the round is `LOCKED` and renders exist. One vote per funded account per round (open item: whether the vote is stake-weighted).

Deliberately separate from the parimutuel pool: voting decides the fan-favorite result only and never affects the conformance outcome. The two clocks stay intact — betting closed before anything rendered, and voting starts after.

Acceptance criteria:

- Voting is impossible before `LOCKED`.
- A user cannot vote twice in a round.
- The tally is queryable and feeds the fan-favorite award in F18.
- Voting never mutates the conformance result.

Source: `REQUIREMENTS.md`
